more than.en: My grandma is more than sixty years old now.
more than.zh: 我奶奶现在超过六十岁了。

thousand.en: There are one thousand meters in a kilometre.

kilometre.en: The park is about two kilometres from my home.
kilometre.zh: 公园离我家大约两公里远。

something.en: Can you show me something interesting in your bag?
something.zh: 你能给我看你包里有趣的东西吗？

million.en: Our city has more than one million people living here.
million.zh: 我们的城市有超过一百万人住在这里。

map.en: I use a map to find the way to school.
map.zh: 我用地图找到上学的路。

right.en: Your answer to the maths question is right.
right.zh: 你对这道数学题的答案是正确的。

country.en: China is a big and beautiful country in Asia.
country.zh: 中国是亚洲一个又大又美丽的国家。

dancing.en: My sister loves dancing to pop music after school.
dancing.zh: 我妹妹放学后喜欢跟着流行音乐跳舞。

Chinatown.en: We eat delicious dumplings in Chinatown every weekend.
Chinatown.zh: 我们每个周末在唐人街吃美味的饺子。

sometimes.en: I sometimes walk my dog in the park after dinner.
sometimes.zh: 我有时晚饭后去公园遛狗。

shop.en: There is a small shop near our school selling snacks.
shop.zh: 我们学校附近有一家卖零食的小商店。

then.en: If you finish your homework, then you can watch TV.
then.zh: 如果你完成作业，那么你就可以看电视。

ah.en: Ah, I see the beautiful rainbow in the sky!
ah.zh: 啊，我看到天空中美丽的彩虹了！

strong.en: My dad is very strong and can lift heavy boxes.
strong.zh: 我爸爸很强壮，能举起重箱子。

collect.en: I like to collect seashells on the beach every summer.
collect.zh: 我喜欢每年夏天在海滩上收集贝壳。

stamp.en: This stamp from Japan has a picture of a cherry blossom.
stamp.zh: 这张来自日本的邮票上有樱花的图案。

hobby.en: Reading books is a wonderful hobby for rainy days.
hobby.zh: 读书是下雨天的一种极好爱好。

doll.en: My little sister sleeps with her favorite doll every night.
doll.zh: 我妹妹每晚都抱着她最喜欢的玩具娃娃睡觉。

bicycle.en: I ride my bicycle to school every morning with my friend.
bicycle.zh: 我每天早上和朋友一起骑自行车上学。

Thanksgiving.en: We eat turkey and pumpkin pie on Thanksgiving with our family.
Thanksgiving.zh: 感恩节我们和家人一起吃火鸡和南瓜派。

flag.en: The red flag waves in the wind on top of the building.
flag.zh: 红旗在大楼顶上的风中飘扬。

Flag Day.en: On Flag Day, we proudly display our national flag at home.
Flag Day.zh: 在国旗制定纪念日，我们自豪地在家里展示国旗。

fly.en: Children love to fly colorful kites in the park on windy days.
fly.zh: 孩子们喜欢在有风的日子里在公园放彩色风筝。

special.en: My grandma made a special cake for my birthday.
special.zh: 我奶奶为我的生日做了一个特别的蛋糕。

meal.en: We usually have a big meal on New Year's Eve.
meal.zh: 我们通常在除夕吃一顿大餐。

sound.en: The idea of going to the park sounds great.
sound.zh: 去公园的主意听起来很棒。

football.en: My brother loves to play football with his friends.
football.zh: 我哥哥喜欢和他的朋友们玩橄榄球。

moon cake.en: I like eating moon cakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
moon cake.zh: 我喜欢在中秋节吃月饼。

the Mid-Autumn Festival.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family reunion.
the Mid-Autumn Festival.zh: 中秋节是家人团聚的时刻。

the Dragon Boat Festival.en: We eat zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival every year.
the Dragon Boat Festival.zh: 我们每年端午节都吃粽子。

race.en: There is a boat race on the river today.
race.zh: 今天河上有一场划船比赛。

lantern.en: She made a red lantern for the Lantern Festival.
lantern.zh: 她为元宵节做了一个红灯笼。

the Lantern Festival.en: The Lantern Festival marks the end of the Spring Festival.
the Lantern Festival.zh: 元宵节标志着春节的结束。

hang.en: We hang colorful lights on the tree at Christmas.
hang.zh: 圣诞节我们在树上挂彩灯。

pen friend.en: I write to my pen friend in Australia every month.
pen friend.zh: 我每个月给在澳大利亚的笔友写信。

Pleased to meet you!.en: I am pleased to meet you at the school party.
Pleased to meet you!.zh: 我很高兴在学校聚会上见到你。

address.en: Please write your address on this paper.
address.zh: 请在这张纸上写下你的地址。

French.en: My friend can speak French very well.
French.zh: 我的朋友法语说得很好。

age.en: What is the age of your little brother?

story.en: My grandma told me a funny story last night.
story.zh: 昨晚奶奶给我讲了一个有趣的故事。

candy.en: I bought some candy for my sister today.
candy.zh: 今天我给我妹妹买了一些糖果。

world.en: I want to travel around the world one day.
world.zh: 我希望有一天能环游世界。

often.en: I often read books before I go to bed.

difficult.en: This math problem is very difficult for me.
difficult.zh: 这道数学题对我来说很难。

knife.en: Please use a knife to cut the bread.

fork.en: He eats noodles with a fork and spoon.
fork.zh: 他用叉子和勺子吃面条。

chopsticks.en: It is hard to use chopsticks at first.

Japanese.en: My aunt bought a beautiful Japanese fan in Tokyo.
Japanese.zh: 我阿姨在东京买了一把漂亮的日本扇子。

believe.en: I believe you can finish the homework on time.
believe.zh: 我相信你能按时完成作业。

snake.en: The snake is sleeping under the big rock.
snake.zh: 那条蛇正在大石头下面睡觉。

DVD.en: We watched a funny movie on the DVD last night.
DVD.zh: 昨晚我们用DVD看了一部有趣的电影。

together.en: Let's sing the birthday song together for Mom.
together.zh: 让我们一起为妈妈唱生日歌。

lucky.en: I felt lucky to find my lost wallet on the bus.
lucky.zh: 我觉得很幸运，在公交车上找到了丢失的钱包。

bamboo.en: Pandas need fresh bamboo to eat every day.
bamboo.zh: 熊猫每天都需要吃新鲜的竹子。

its.en: The cat is cleaning its paws with its tongue.
its.zh: 猫在用舌头清理它的爪子。

body.en: Regular exercise helps keep your body healthy.
body.zh: 定期锻炼有助于保持身体健康。

come out of.en: The little rabbit will come out of the hole soon.
come out of.zh: 小兔子很快就会从洞里出来。

flute.en: My brother is learning to play the bamboo flute.
flute.zh: 我哥哥正在学习吹竹笛。

get.en: It will get very cold when the sun goes down.
get.zh: 太阳下山时天气会变得很冷。

frightened.en: The little girl was frightened by the loud thunder last night.
frightened.zh: 昨晚那个小女孩被响雷吓坏了。

long ago.en: Long ago, people used candles to light their homes.
long ago.zh: 很久以前，人们用蜡烛照亮他们的家。

I’d love to.en: I’d love to go to the park with you this weekend.
I’d love to.zh: 我很乐意这个周末和你一起去公园。

not really.en: Do you like eating spicy food? Not really, it’s too hot.
not really.zh: 你喜欢吃辣的食物吗？不全是，太辣了。

stop.en: Please stop running in the hallway, it’s dangerous.
stop.zh: 请停止在走廊里跑，这很危险。

clean.en: I help my mom clean the kitchen after dinner every day.
clean.zh: 每天晚饭后我都帮妈妈打扫厨房。

camera.en: My dad bought a new camera to take photos on our trip.
camera.zh: 我爸爸买了一个新相机用来在旅行中拍照。

show.en: Can you show me your new toy car after class?
show.zh: 下课后你能给我看看你的新玩具车吗？

never.en: I never forget to brush my teeth before going to bed.

around.en: There are many beautiful flowers around our school garden.
around.zh: 我们学校花园四周有很多美丽的花。

all around.en: We saw colorful balloons all around the festival square.
all around.zh: 我们在节日广场到处都看到彩色气球。

member state.en: Japan is a member state of the United Nations.
member state.zh: 日本是联合国的一个成员国。

inside.en: Please come inside the house, it is raining outside.
inside.zh: 请到房子里来，外面在下雨。

should.en: You should brush your teeth every morning.

line.en: There is a long line at the supermarket.

stand in line.en: We must stand in line to buy tickets.

close.en: Please close the door when you leave.

librarian.en: The librarian helped me find a book.
librarian.zh: 图书馆管理员帮我找到了一本书。

rule.en: One rule is to keep the library clean.
rule.zh: 一条规定是保持图书馆干净。

quiet.en: Please be quiet in the library.
quiet.zh: 在图书馆里请保持安静。

problem.en: I have a problem with my homework.
problem.zh: 我的家庭作业遇到了问题。

No problem..en: Can you help me? No problem.

cross.en: Look both ways before you cross the street.
